# Unit Resources

If you’d like to participate in the Summer of Service as a unit, there are
many resources available for you. Collaborate with participating families to
identify a suitable initiative and go for it! Get creative! This is a terrific
way to keep Scouts and families engaged during the summer.

## Project Ideas

  * [Health & Wellness](https://www.scouting.org/summerofservice/health-wellness/)
  * [The Environment](https://www.scouting.org/summerofservice/the-environment/)
  * [Neighbors In-Need](https://www.scouting.org/summerofservice/neighbors-in-need/)
  * [Our Communities](https://www.scouting.org/summerofservice/our-communities/)

## **Ask**  

When in doubt, ask!  If you have questions about the appropriateness of a
service project, talk with your unit leader.  Unit leadership will be able to
provide guidance as needed.  

### **Get Involved**  

It’s simple!  Get involved in a few easy steps!

  1. Find a way to serve others – _Whether it’s a spur-the-moment opportunity or a planned project, there are many ways to serve._
  2. Do your project or activity – _April 1 – October 31_  
  3. Show your Scout Spirit – _Post about your service on social media…and tag others to do the same!__  Use hashtag #S_ _ummerOfService_ _._  
  4. Tell us about what you did – _Click the button below to tell us about your service!   We’ll add your hours to the amazing national impact!_ 
  5. Celebrate! – _Print certificates and order patches to commemorate your service!_   

[ Report your Project ](https://scouting.jotform.com/210415264075852)

## **Recognition**  

When you’re ready to commemorate your service, print certificates and order
patches here!

[ Print My Certificate ](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2021/03/Certificate-of-Appreciation.pdf)

[ Order My Patch ](https://tradingpost.classb.com/summer-of-service/)
